name: Kiyoh Reviews
author: converzo

sections.description:
Kiyoh Reviews integrates your WooCommerce store with the Kiyoh review platform. Automatically send review invitations to customers after purchase and display both company and product reviews on your store.

Features

  • Automatic Review Invitations – Send review invitations automatically when orders reach a specific status (completed or processing)
  • Manual Review Invitations – Send invitations manually from the WooCommerce order actions dropdown
  • Product Reviews – Display Kiyoh product reviews on your WooCommerce product pages, integrated with native WooCommerce reviews
  • Company Reviews Widget – Show your overall company rating using the included WordPress widget
  • Product Sync – Sync your WooCommerce product catalog with Kiyoh
  • Multi-language Support – Send review invitations in the customer’s language based on billing country or a default language
  • Configurable Delay – Set a delay before review invitations are sent
  • Debug Logging – Enable debug mode to troubleshoot API interactions
  • Duplicate Prevention – Automatic invitations are only sent once per order

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or higher
  • WooCommerce
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Kiyoh account with API access
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/kiyoh-reviews, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Kiyoh to configure the plugin
  4. Enter your Kiyoh API key, location ID, and server URL
  5. Enable review invitations and configure your preferred settings
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Kiyoh API credentials?

Log in to your Kiyoh account and navigate to the API settings section to find your API key and location ID.

Can I customize when review invitations are sent?

Yes, you can choose to send invitations when orders are marked as “completed” or “processing”. You can also set a delay in seconds before the invitation is sent.

Can I send review invitations manually?

Yes, you can send a review invitation manually from any order by selecting “Send Kiyoh review invitation” from the order actions dropdown.

Are invitations sent multiple times if an order status changes?

No, automatic invitations are only sent once per order. However, you can always send additional invitations manually if needed.
